workflow.receipt_role: EVIDENCE_AND_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT; WORKFLOW_STATE remains the workflow SOT
workflow.acceptance_basis: Exact scoped diff, reference/source review, targeted tests, Guardian plugin plus repo fallback evidence, authenticated production browser CRUD proof, cleanup verification and remote branch verification completed.

root_cause.ui: Client Detail used a legacy inline contact editor instead of the populated canonical client edit form; the repair added one controlled edit owner, populated fields and real update/delete wiring.
root_cause.auth: The canonical Supabase /auth/v1/user response uses id, but shared request context accepted only legacy user_id/sub aliases, so authenticated activity calls returned AUTH_ACTOR_REQUIRED.
root_cause.guard: The A26 guard had drifted from the consolidated activities handler, canonical /api/activities route and current migration name; its source expectations were reconciled.

changed_paths.change: Shared controlled create/edit form owner and real client mutation boundary.
Client detail uses the populated edit dialog and preserves scoped update/delete callbacks.
Reference-aligned edit modal order, responsive layout and VST semantic tokens.
Scoped GET reads use no-store semantics to prevent stale client data during CRUD verification.
Scoped client reads send explicit private no-store response headers.
Verified request context accepts the canonical Supabase user id while preserving legacy aliases.
Regression coverage for the canonical /auth/v1/user response shape.
Guard follows the consolidated activities route, scoped delete source and current migration.
Final authenticated production CRUD proof with synthetic cleanup and browser diagnostic boundary.
Current plugin-first and repo-fallback results with stale baseline findings classified.

verification.targeted_tests: PASS 31/31 including canonical auth context, FRT-015 activity privacy, FRT-026 detail, FRT-029 client add, FRT-030 client edit and HTTP cache regressions

verification.guards: Scoped FRT-030/A22/A26, route, semantic icon/color/typography, Stage124, urgent regression, server-secret and Supabase architecture/auth guards PASS; installed Guardian coverage PARTIAL with zero scoped blockers
